fact: Belmoney and DigiPay Group launched the DigiTransfer app, sending money from France and Belgium to mobile wallets and bank accounts in the Republic of Congo within minutes.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY, live since July 2020, carries domestic and cross-border payments within the six CEMAC states including the Republic of Congo.
AfricaNenda says the Republic of Congo is one of the six CEMAC states served by GIMACPAY, a regional interoperability platform in service.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY processed about 10 million transactions worth $657 million in 2022 across all six states, domestic and cross-border combined.
Congo is one of six CEMAC states on GIMACPAY, the regional platform whose interoperable QR Code standard was launched on 29 July 2026.
Congo takes part in GIMACPAY, the CEMAC regional payment platform operated by GIMAC.
GIMAC reported that the regional GIMACPAY platform processed 20.3 million transactions worth FCFA 863 billion in 2025, up 40% by volume, across the six CEMAC states.
BEAC joined PAPSS, announced by Afreximbank on 9 July 2026, and CEMAC banks are to be connected to it by end-2026.

Belmoney and DigiPay Group launched the DigiTransfer app enabling transfers from France and Belgium to mobile money wallets and bank accounts in the Republic of Congo; the service is limited to outbound transfers from those two countries.

TechAfrica News reports on 9 July 2026 that BEAC, serving the Republic of Congo among six CEMAC states, has joined PAPSS, which connects 28 countries and 16 switches, with operationalisation and onboarding of CEMAC institutions planned through end 2026.
